# todo

A tiny in-memory todo list.

Run the tests: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`.

Release with `scripts/release.sh`.

#!/bin/sh
# Tag the current commit and publish it.
set -e
version=$(python3 -c 'import todo; print(todo.__version__)')
git tag "v$version"
git push origin main "v$version"
